name: Waterfall
author: RussoDaFederal
description:
Enables creating an animated waterfall. The waterfall will replace the graphics of a given map object.

Credits to Mugen87 (https://github.com/Mugen87) for creating this ThreeJS waterfall: https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/funny-lake-7rkse. I mostly just ported that code to RPM.

Tip: if you use blue (0x00ff00) for the dark colors and white (0xffffff) for the light colors, you'll get a decent enough effect. Try combining different colors to achieve the result you want!

Warning! If you have downloaded this plugin directly from the engine, there might be missing files. You can download the missing files from GitHub on the provided link or from the RPG Paper Maker Discord server.

commands.name: Create waterfall
commands.description: Turn a Map Object into a waterfall (will replace its graphics)

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the Map Object that will become the waterfall. -1 is self

defaultParameters.name: diameter
defaultParameters.description: Diameter of the waterfall, in squares

defaultParameters.name: height
defaultParameters.description: Height of the waterfall, in squares

defaultParameters.name: shape
defaultParameters.description: Shape of the waterfall. 1 = cylinder; 2 = box; 3 = sphere; 4 = plane

defaultParameters.name: speed
defaultParameters.description: The animation speed of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: topDark
defaultParameters.description: Dark color to mix to the top of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: bottomDark
defaultParameters.description: Dark color to mix to the bottom of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: topLight
defaultParameters.description: Light color to mix to the top of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: bottomLight
defaultParameters.description: Light color to mix to the bottom of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: foamColor
defaultParameters.description: Color of the waterfall's foam at the bottom

defaultParameters.name: addFoam
defaultParameters.description: Whether to add foam or not

defaultParameters.name: opacity
defaultParameters.description: The opacity of the waterfall, from 0 to 1. 0 is invisible, 1 is fully opaque

commands.name: Set opacity
commands.description: Change the opacity of the waterfall

defaultParameters.name: id
defaultParameters.description: ID of the map object where the waterfall is. -1 is self, 0 is hero

defaultParameters.name: opacity
defaultParameters.description: Opacity value ranging from 0 to 1. 0 is invisible and 1 is fully opaque
